title: General Application
text:
We are always looking for top talent although Mitra Chem is currently not hiring. If you come from a lithium-ion battery company or research project, we will review your application and get back to you as soon as we have a suitable opening to talk to you about. We look forward to your application.
Review our recent headlines on our News page , and follow us on LinkedIn for live updates.
Mitra Chem is a growth-stage startup developing sustainable Li-ion battery cathodes in the heart of Silicon Valley. Our high-throughput acceleration platform shortens the lab-to-production timeline by >90% through vertically integrated process optimization and cutting-edge artificial intelligence applications. Our iron-rich cathodes are industry proven drivers of EV, ESS, and consumer electronics applications, and our team of industry leaders is developing a robust supply chain and manufacturing pipeline to deliver Inflation Reduction Act (IRA) qualified cathodes to our customers.
We have set up a state-of-the-art 15,000 sq ft industrial R&D center in Mountain View, CA. Join our team and be a part of the growing battery revolution.

- Comprehensive benefits including health, vision and dental insurance, and 401K.
- Tax-free spending accounts, along with life and disability insurances

title: Lab Technician
text:
Mitra Chem is an AI-enabled innovator and manufacturer of critical materials powering the future of energy, AI, and defense. We combine advanced materials science, manufacturing, and artificial intelligence to dramatically accelerate the journey from lab-scale innovation to commercial production. Our team of chemists, engineers, data scientists, and manufacturing professionals is tackling some of the hardest challenges in critical-materials scale-up while helping build more resilient domestic supply chains.
At Mitra Chem, we stay curious, win together , pursue our work with purpose, and put safety and well-being first. If you’re energized by complex problems, rapid innovation, and the opportunity to build technology with real-world impact , we’d like to hear from you!
We are seeking a motivated and meticulous Laboratory Technician to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for the precise synthesis and measurement of materials essential to our daily operations. You will work under the guidance of Scientists and/or Engineers to ensure that all experimental and production inputs meet our rigorous standards for quality and accuracy.
Key responsibilities include but not limited to:
-
Material synthesis: Weigh precursors, run synthesis equipment including bead mills, spray dryers, and furnaces, and clean and maintain equipment
-
Materials characterization : Measure key materials properties using techniques such as X-ray diffraction, SEM, and press density and clean sample holders
-
Battery fabrication: build batteries to qualify materials
-
Data documentation: Maintain clear, organized records of all precursor weights, process parameters, and measurements in the Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS)
-
Safety & Compliance: Adhere strictly to safety protocols (PPE, chemical handling, and waste disposal) and maintain a clean, organized workspace.
-
Lab Operations and Maintenance : Participate in reporting issues and maintaining equipment, stocking consumables, and keeping the lab orderly. Clean laboratory glassware and tools.
Qualifications:
-
Experience working in characterization or materials synthesis laboratory or similar industrial environments
-
Clear written and verbal communication
-
Congenial and friendly relationship with coworkers
-
Basic computer skills including using email, creating and editing spreadsheets and documents in G-Suite and MS Office
-
Ability to lift, squat, kneel, use step ladders, manipulate hand and power tools
-
May be required to wear hearing protection and if respiratory protection is needed then the applicant may be required to maintain facial hair compatible with a tight fitting respirator.
Experience & Technical Skills:
-
Demonstrated experience in carefully weighing and measuring materials using balances and other laboratory equipment
-
High degree of accuracy in performing repetitive tasks and handling small quantities of material
-
Ability to document procedures and results clearly and concisely
-
Strong grasp of basic lab mathematics, including dilutions and metric unit conversions.
Benefits:
-
Competitive compensation package including company equity and bonus plans
-
Comprehensive benefits including health, vision and dental insurance, Tax-free spending accounts, along with life and disability insurances
-
401k matching and savings programs
-
Flexible time off with company holidays
-
Free daily lunch and snacks
